paite: Pathian aw, nidanglai a adam lai ua na thilhihte ka pipute un hon hilh uh ka bil un ka za ua.
heading: Humbitna Dia Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. A contemplative psalm. We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

paite: Namte na khut in na hawlkhia a, amaute na phut a; mite na hihgim a, na paikhia hi.
english: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

paite: Gam luah ding a amau namsau a alak uh ahi kei a, amau ban a kihumbit leng ahi kei uh; atung ua na kipah ziak in na khut taklam, na ban leh, na mel vak in ahi zaw.
english: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

paite: Pathian aw, nang ka Kumpipa na hi; Jakob humbitna ding in thu pia in.
english: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!

paite: Nangmah ziak in ka melmate uh ka si pai ding ua; na min ziak in hon sualte ka chil ekek ding uhi.
english: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.

paite: Ka thalpeu ka muang kei ding a, ka namsau in hon hondam sam kei ding.
english: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.

paite: Hon doute lak ah na hon hondam zawta a, hon hote na zaklaksak behlap hi.
english: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

paite: Nitum in Pathian ka suang ding ua, na min tangtawn in ka phat ding uhi. Selah
english: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

paite: Tu'n zaw nang na hon khahkhia a, na hon hihzum a; ka sepaihhonte uh toh na pawtkhe ngei kei hi.
english: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.

paite: Melmate lak ah na hon taizaksak a; hon hote'n gallak adeihdeih uh ala uhi.
english: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

paite: Nang nek ding belam bang in na hon pia a; namte lak ah na hon hihdalh behlap hi.
english: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

paite: Na mite bangmah lou in na khawngta a, aman uh lah atam het kei hi.
english: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

paite: Nang ka kim ua mite gensiat in na hon omsak a, ka kiangnai ua mite muhsit leh nuihsan in na hon omsak hi.
english: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

paite: Nang namte lak ah aselam gentehna in na hon omsak a, michih lak a mite lu sinkhum in na hon omsak hi.
english: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

paite: Ka buaina nitum in ka ma ah a-om gige a, ka zahlakna in hon tuam zouta hi.
english: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

paite: Genthangmi leh gensemi aw ziak leh, melma leh phulami ziak in.
english: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

paite: Huai tengteng ka tung uah atung a; himahleh ka hon mangngilh ngei kei ua, na thukhun ah zuau in ka hih ngei kei uhi.
english: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.

paite: Ka lungtang uh akihei nawn kei a, ka kalsuante'n na lampi apaisan ngei kei hi.
english: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

paite: Nang sehalte omna ah na hon bawl ek a, sihna lim a na hon tuamna ding in.
english: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

paite: I Pathian min i mangngilh a, gamdang pathian lam a i khutte i zakleh
english: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,

paite: Pathian in huai azongkhe kei dia hia! Lungtang thugukte atheigige a.
english: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

paite: Ahi, nangmah ziak in thah in ka om gige ua; belam goh dingte bang a seh ka hi uhi.
english: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

paite: TOUPA aw, halh tanla, bang achia ihmu! Hak inla, tangtawn in hon khahkhe ke'n.
english: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.

paite: Bangziak in ahia na mai na sel a, ka haksatdan uleh nuaisiah ka thuakdan uh na mangngilh nak.
english: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

paite: Ka hinna uh leivui si in akun a; ka gilpi uh lah lei ah abelh bikbek hi.
english: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

paite: Hon panpih ding in thou inla, na zahngaihna ziak in hon tan in.
english: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
